Dream Holidays

Talk about the trips you'd love to take — and learn how English uses verbs after love, like, hate, want and would like.

🎯 Grammar: verb patterns (-ing / to + verb) 📊 Level A2 ⏱️ About 70 min 🎧 3 audio clips
Warm-up ~5 min · let's talk

Five holidays. One question.

Look at the photos. Which holiday do you like best? Tell your teacher why, and one thing you would not like about it.

Say it like this

“I really like , because…”

“I wouldn't like — it's too…”

Presentation ~6 min · the rule

Verb patterns

When two verbs come together, the second verb changes. Here is the rule.

love · like · enjoy · don't mind · hate  +  verb-ing
I love travelling by train.  ·  She hates flying.  ·  I don't mind getting the bus.
want · would like ('d like)  +  to + verb
I'd like to visit Calcutta one day.  ·  What do you want to do in California?

⚠️ Careful: would like always takes to + verb — never -ing.

4Sort the verbs

Drag each verb into the right box — or just tap it. Which pattern does it use?

enjoy want hate would like love don't mind like

+ verb-ing

e.g. love flying

+ to + verb

e.g. want to fly

6Complete the conversation

Write the verb from the box in the correct form. Use each verb once.

cook  ·  do  ·  go  ·  learn  ·  stay  ·  travel  ·  try

A: I'd like on a special holiday this year.

B: Really? What do you want ?

A: I'm not sure. But I enjoy new things and different food on holiday.

B: Do you like ? There are holidays in Italy where you can learn to cook with a local chef.

A: That's a great idea! I'd like how to cook Italian food! How about you?

B: Oh no. I hate ! I want at home and relax!

Word stress & rhythm

Production ~15 min · over to you

Plan your dream trip

Now use everything. Plan a special trip, make some notes, then tell your teacher about it using the verb patterns.

8Make your notes

Think about these questions and jot down a few words for each.

Where?Where would you like to go?
What?What would you like to do there?
How?How do you want to travel?
Need?What will you need to take?
How long?How long do you want to go for?

9Tell your teacher

Speak for about a minute. Use at least four of these patterns. Tick them off as you say them.

Useful sentences

“I'd like to go to .”

“I love -ing and I really enjoy -ing.”

“I don't mind -ing, but I hate -ing.”

“I want to and I 'd like to .”
